description.value: Rosemary Rocksalt is a Montreal-style bagel shop on Vancouver's cycling-friendly Commercial Drive, hand-rolling and stone-baking honey-boiled bagels fresh each day in an open-flame hearth oven. The menu spans breakfast sandwiches, deli-style bagel sandwiches using wild BC sockeye salmon and Montreal smoked meat, and take-home dozens — making it a practical fuelling or stocking-up stop mid-ride. The shop operates three Metro Vancouver locations, with the Commercial Drive outpost sitting at the heart of one of the city's busiest cycling corridors.
